components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bold pill button used for the main call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #0F172A; color: #F8F7F4; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill button with an inset stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; border: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #0F172A; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Layer Card
components.description: Dark card used in the detector-layers section for each Whale product module.
components.html:
SpaceSight

AI audit platform for space and facilities.
components.css: .ds-layer-card { background: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.1); border-radius: 18px; padding: 3rem 1.5rem; color: #F8F7F4; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-layer-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.25); } .ds-layer-card h3 { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-layer-card p { color: #94A3B8; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Use Case Card
components.description: Light card with an orbital icon and a short description.
components.html:
Sales Floor Intelligence

Score every customer interaction across 40+ languages.
components.css: .ds-usecase-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1.5rem; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-usecase-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); } .ds-usecase-icon { flex: 0 0 64px; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #FFD23F; } .ds-usecase-card h3 { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-usecase-card p { color: #475569; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Terminal Panel
components.description: Dark code panel styled like a terminal window.
components.css: .ds-terminal { background: #0B1020; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-terminal-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-terminal-header span:nth-child(1) { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF4B4B; } .ds-terminal-header span:nth-child(2) { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFD23F; } .ds-terminal-header span:nth-child(3) { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00E5FF; } .ds-terminal-header span:nth-child(4) { margin-left: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-terminal-body { margin: 0; padding: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #00E5FF; overflow-x: auto; }

components.name: Track Legend Button
components.description: Pill button that isolates a particle track in the WebGL hero.
components.css: .ds-track-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.5); font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #475569; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-track-btn span { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFD23F; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FFD23F; } .ds-track-btn:hover { background: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.9); color: #0F172A; } .ds-track-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFD23F; color: #0F172A; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1); } .ds-track-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: CTA Input
components.description: Dark translucent pill input used in the CTA section.
components.css: .ds-cta-input { flex: 1 1 240px; padding: 0.85rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.2); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.08); color: #F8F7F4; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-cta-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-cta-input:focus, .ds-cta-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #00E5FF; outline-offset: 3px; border-color: #00E5FF; background: rgba(248, 247, 244, 0.12); }

narrative.overview: Whale's visual world treats every visit as a single multimodal collision event. The interface borrows the spare, scientific notation of high-energy physics — concentric detector rings, colored particle tracks, and deposited-energy markers — but renders it on a warm, bright ground so the result feels approachable rather than archival. The system is built for B2B buyers who need to trust Whale's operations platform, but it refuses the dark, dense aesthetic that enterprise AI sites usually inherit. The page moves from the macro (the full-bleed interactive detector) to the micro (spec numbers in tabular mono) and back out to the human outcome (use cases, integration code, contact). Color is functional first: yellow for SpaceSight video, cyan for Echo voice, magenta for Alivia orchestration. The same three colors thread through every section, so the visitor learns the palette as they scroll.
keyCharacteristics: Bright vacuum-chamber white ground with one deep-ink section for contrast.
Signal tracks in yellow, cyan, and magenta carry meaning across the whole site.
Technical grotesk display type (Chakra Petch) paired with a clean body face (Manrope) and tabular mono for data.
Every interactive state is authored; no browser-default focus rings or unstyled hover.
The hero is a real WebGL stage, not a decorative illustration.

rules.name: Signal-Color Rule
rules.body: Yellow, cyan, and magenta always map to SpaceSight video, Echo voice, and Alivia orchestration respectively. Never use them as generic decoration; their meaning is the interface.

rules.name: One Ink Section Rule
rules.body: Only one major section (CTA/footer) uses the near-black/detecto-ink ground. The rest of the page lives in daylight to keep the energy light, not moody.

rules.name: Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline letter-spacing is always -0.04em or tighter. The technical face needs to feel locked in, not floating.

rules.name: Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Space Mono appears only for numbers, code, command labels, and small technical callouts. Never for marketing headlines or body text.

rules.name: Full-Bleed Hero Rule
rules.body: Only the hero and its WebGL canvas are full-bleed. Every other section respects the shared container.

rules.name: Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, active). No decorative drop shadows under static cards.

rules.name: Orbital Base Rule
rules.body: Circles and rings are the default motif. Angular shapes appear only inside iconography when the meaning demands it.

dos: Do use yellow, cyan, and magenta exclusively for SpaceSight video, Echo voice, and Alivia orchestration respectively.
Do keep the page in daylight; use the detector-ink ground only for the terminal panel and CTA/footer.
Do use Chakra Petch for all headlines and Manrope for body text.
Do reserve Space Mono for data, code, and small technical labels.
Do make every interactive element respond with authored hover/focus/active states.
Do let the WebGL hero remain the dominant first impression.
donts: Don't add decorative section numbers (01, 02, 03) unless the sequence itself is required navigation.
Don't use glass or blur as a decorative header effect.
Don't rely on browser-default focus outlines.
Don't use monospace for marketing copy or display type.
Don't make every section the same card grid.
Don't introduce new accent colors that compete with the three signal tracks.
